questions.question: What event takes place in chapter 8?
options: The ordination of Aaron and his sons as priests
The making of the golden calf at Sinai
The first Passover before the exodus
The dividing of the whole land among the twelve tribes
questions.answer: The ordination of Aaron and his sons as priests
